continuous_text.title: Look at the Animals
continuous_text.content:
Look over here!
Look over there!
There are animals
Everywhere!

What is it?
It's a duck.
What's it doing?
It's flying up high!

What is it?
It's a dog!
What's it doing?
It's jumping with the frogs!

What are they?
They're goats!
What are they doing?
They're eating some oats!
Chorus

continuous_text.title: It's Eating Your Skirt!
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1:
Jane: Is that your cat?
Maria: Yes, it is.
Frame 2:
Jane: What's it doing?
Maria: It's jumping.
Frame 3:
Jane: What's the duck doing?
Maria: It's flying.
Frame 4:
Jane: What are the chickens doing?
Maria: They're running.
Frame 5:
Jane: Maria, what's the goat doing?
Frame 6:
Maria: Shoo! Shoo!
Jane: Oh, no! It's eating your skirt!
continuous_text.notes: Frames 1-4 on p. 98; frames 5-6 on p. 99; track 159

continuous_text.title: Content Connection: Baby Animals
continuous_text.content:
1 Look at the cows. The big cow is brown. She has a baby cow. A baby cow is called a calf.
2 The big dog is happy. Look at her baby dogs. Baby dogs are called puppies.
3 This chicken is very big. Look at the baby chickens. They're called chicks.
4 Look at the cats. There's one big cat and three baby cats. Baby cats are called kittens.

continuous_text.title: Culture Connection: Pets
continuous_text.content:
1 I'm Sharon. I'm from Australia. This is my pet hamster. He's brown. His name's Charlie.
2 My name's Reiko. I'm from Japan. I have a pet canary. He's yellow. His name's Tom Bird.
3 Hi. My name's Zack. I'm from the United States. I have a pet snake. She's green. Her name's Samantha.
4 I'm Elina. I'm from Greece. This is my pet mouse. She's very small. She's white. Her name's Zoe.

curriculum_components.title: On the Farm
curriculum_components.description: Vocabulary presentation for 10 common domestic and farm animals.

curriculum_components.title: Look at the Animals
curriculum_components.description: Chant combining animal names and actions in the present continuous.

curriculum_components.title: It's Eating Your Skirt!
curriculum_components.description: Six-panel farm narrative practicing present continuous animal actions.

curriculum_components.title: What's the goat doing? / What are the chickens doing?
curriculum_components.description: Singular and plural present continuous questions and statements for animal actions.

curriculum_components.title: Baby animals
curriculum_components.description: Identifying and classifying baby animals (calf, chick, kitten, puppy).

curriculum_components.title: Baby Animals poster
curriculum_components.description: Creating and presenting a poster about baby animals.

curriculum_components.title: Possessive determiners
curriculum_components.description: Full paradigm of possessive determiners (my, your, his, her, its, our, your, their).

curriculum_components.title: Pets
curriculum_components.description: Children and their pets across different countries (Australia, Japan, USA, Greece).

curriculum_components.title: Be nice to animals.
curriculum_components.description: Practicing compassionate care habits for animals (feeding, walking, brushing, playing).

curriculum_components.title: r, h, j
curriculum_components.description: Letter-sound relationships and word blending for /r/, /h/, and /dʒ/ (j).

curriculum_components.title: Review
curriculum_components.description: Consolidation and self-assessment of Unit 6 targets.
